Only four separately adjudicated WP6 sources are eligible for approved-derived projection. Reuse-confirmed status on other sources does not promote them beyond receipt-bound context. review_checks.evidence: Packet acquisition_target_commit equals governed constant ae690c19b83147cbaa6dd2b00b177e3fd25910da. The builder defaults to it; the validator rejects a mismatch or malformed value; the acquisition-target mismatch unit test passes.

review_checks.qualification: Product/organisation/month quantities and indicative costs cannot establish patient count, indication, duration, list or net price, budget impact, or displacement.

review_checks.evidence: Finalised SCMD 202603 and provisional SCMD 202605 remain separately identified and hashed. Acoramidis occurs only provisionally. PCA zero matches are treated as community-versus-secondary-care scope divergence, not clinical absence.

MHRA/EMA authorisation, ClinicalTrials.gov registry, NICE appraisal/resource-impact, NHSBSA administrative, and company disclosure roles remain distinct. NICE records the acoramidis model price as confidential; NHSBSA indicative cost is not used as list or net price. No regulator, HTA, payer, reimbursement, policy, confidential-price, or comparative cost-effectiveness conclusion is created.

Organisation, service, medicine, formulary, guidance, aggregate, authority-rank, and rights fields are not converted into a displaced programme. Stable displaced-programme ID, baseline unit, baseline cost, and causal displacement remain deferred.

Approved-derived output is limited to Crossref facts, ClinicalTrials.gov registry metadata with its submitted-information warning, NICE reference-case discounting facts, and bounded CC BY-NC relative-survival methods. Treatment effects, hazards, utilities, costs, prices, population, uptake, displacement, and calibrated Chapter 7 parameters are excluded.

Provisional status and structural uncertainty are retained; missing economic fields are not imputed; parameter_roles is empty; no joint parameter distribution exists; packet authority is repository-derived and not Atlas-approved; empirical calibration remains disabled and decision use prohibited.

Eight maximal-public-data tests pass, including acquisition-target mismatch, stale bundle, empirical promotion, parameter role, missing hash, and missing bundle failures. Maximal-data validation passes with complete matrix and authority-rank checks; T13 closeout remains synthetic-research-only.

limitations: Acoramidis is present only in provisional May 2026 SCMD and cannot be treated as finalised activity until the corresponding final release is reconciled.
SCMD is neither patient-level nor indication-specific and cannot identify eligible population, treatment courses, adherence, unit net price, or causal budget impact.

No public evidence supplies an attributable displaced programme, stable displaced-programme ID, baseline unit/cost, confidential price, model-ready treatment effects, utilities, or joint uncertainty distribution.
The complete rights matrix is an inventory control; only the four expressly marked sources feed the narrow approved-derived projection.
Registry information is submitted data, company records are interested-party disclosures, and procurement probes did not establish a query-verifiable award or price.
This subagent review cannot replace NHS, regulator, source-owner, Atlas, restricted-data, or release authority.

invalidation.rule: Invalidate on any change to reviewed commit, packet digest, acquisition target, bundle bytes/hash, source or authority rank, rights classification or permitted use, URL/revision/ETag/Last-Modified, transformation, projection, uncertainty, destination, claim boundary, or promotion status.
invalidation.required_action: Rebuild deterministically; repeat bundle, rights-matrix, acquisition-target, arithmetic, and claims validation; issue a new exact-commit and exact-packet review.
invalidation.provisional_trigger: SCMD_FINAL_202605 publication requires comparison with the provisional receipt before any use of the May observation.
